sentences.text: Netsepoye possessed very broad pectoral fins and a pelvic girdle featuring a very high dorsal process.
The name refers to the Blackfoot Confederacy, suggesting the fossil was found in Blackfoot territory within the Bear Gulch Limestone in Montana, United States.
Netsepoye is mostly known from its teeth, though the head and parts of the body are partially preserved.
Netsepoye belongs to the family Obruchevodidae and is classified in the class Chondrichthyes.
Netsepoye lived between 346.7 and 323.6 million years ago during the Visean to Serpukhovian stages.
